threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it Dalston Junction, not just 'the Junction'. The old timers know it’s just Dalston, innit?
Heard a guy on the 133 insist the driver was in cahoots with his ex because he took a different route. Must've been a long night.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a hipster feeding a pigeon a croissant while discussing existentialism with a street artist on the corner of Weserstraße.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only here do you find a late-night kebab joint with its own art gallery upstairs—where local artists showcase pieces amid the smell of grilled meat.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they can name at least three unofficial street art spots and have a favorite taco truck that’s not on Yelp.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy pull out a saxophone on the 31-Balboa, playing 'Careless Whisper' while everyone paused mid-scroll. Classic San Francisco moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just a party zone, but locals know the quiet corners like Plaça de la Virreina, perfect for a peaceful afternoon.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their unfamiliarity with the metro map—still squinting at it like it's a treasure map. They always look a bit lost.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the sun means it's warm enough to sit outside. Real Hackney residents know a puffer jacket is a year-round essential.
The other night on the 343, a guy was singing show tunes at the top of his lungs. The driver just rolled his eyes and kept driving. Classic Peckham.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I spotted that old man bartering for fresh bread while juggling a parakeet under his arm. Only in Neukölln!

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice how the kebab shops here stay open way past midnight? They're like the unofficial late-night therapy spots after a long night out.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know to avoid 16th and Mission when BART’s down; tourists just stand there looking lost while everyone else takes the bus on Valencia.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy on the 38 Geary chatting up his jade green parrot perched on his shoulder. Only in SF do feathered companions ride public transit like it's normal.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about Parc Güell, but the real charm is in the hidden squares where locals sip café con leche, not in the crowds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they're a newbie when they still pull out their maps at Urgell metro instead of just following the crowd to Plaza Universitat.
